# Gen AI Solutions

> Practical IT and private AI for Irish businesses.

Gen AI Solutions is based in Tralee, Co. Kerry and serves businesses across Ireland. Services cover infrastructure and server setup, websites and maintenance, business email and everyday IT, and private AI with staff training.

Private, offline, self-hosted and open-source AI remains a core service for organisations that handle sensitive information. Data handling depends on the agreed setup. AI outputs need human review. No legal advice or guaranteed compliance is offered.

## Practical starting projects

Infrastructure work can include local servers, workstations, shared storage, backup planning, virtual machines and suitable self-hosted services. Access, changes and handover are agreed before work begins.

Website work can include updates, broken-page repairs, hosting and domain configuration, performance improvements and scoped ongoing maintenance.

Business email work can include domain email, DNS, mail clients, device configuration and review before a proposed migration. Third-party subscriptions and licences are agreed separately.

Private AI projects include local ChatGPT-style assistants, question answering across approved documents with source references, offline transcription and meeting notes, AI privacy reviews and staff training. Sensitive data can stay on the organisation's hardware or controlled infrastructure when that is how the agreed system is designed.

## Enquiries and pricing

Email support@gen-ai-solutions.com or request a 20-minute consultation through the contact page. A time is arranged by reply. Project work is quoted after a scope review. Historical AI guide prices are not current confirmed offers. Do not infer fixed prices, support response guarantees or round-the-clock availability.

Please do not send sensitive files through this form. We can arrange a secure review process.

The general contact form uses external FormSubmit processing and currently forwards enquiries to the existing Hotmail inbox. It is not an offline data workflow. The website also uses its existing Google Analytics 4 configuration, as described in the privacy policy.
